review_basis: Agent review of official question structures and official family formulations; not a released per-instance type label, not an SMT proof of natural language, and not candidate-output filtering.

job_shop.rationale: Fixed-duration precedence and disjunctive machine capacity, binary ordering with a fixed big-M constant; linear makespan.

aircraft_landing.rationale: Landing windows, constant separation times and binary ordering; linear early/late deviation penalties.

traveling_salesman.rationale: Binary arcs, linear visit equalities and linear position-based subtour elimination; fixed arc costs.

fixed_charge_network.rationale: Linear flow balance and fixed-capacity activation; linear fixed opening plus per-unit flow costs.

transit_line_planning.rationale: Line selection and bounded frequencies, fixed per-line capacity coefficients, linear unmet-demand penalty and vehicle limit.

coverage.rationale: Binary tower and coverage choices; fixed coverage incidence, linear budget and population objective.

network_flow.rationale: Linear flow balance, fixed link and optional node capacities; fixed per-unit transportation costs.

team_assignment.rationale: Binary person-project assignment and fixed skill coefficients; linear shortage bounds. Model type review does not validate correctness of all stated skill bounds.

capacitated_lot_sizing.rationale: Linear inventory conservation, resource capacities and binary setup activation; additive setup/production/holding costs.

max_sum_dispersion.rationale: Pairwise binary selection admits exact AND linearization z<=x_i, z<=x_j, z>=x_i+x_j-1; objective sums fixed pairwise scores.

hours_assignment.rationale: Continuous assigned hours with fixed supply, demand and contribution limits; linear hourly costs.

flow_shop.rationale: Binary job-position assignment; linear time precedence with fixed processing times; linear final completion objective.

unit_commitment.rationale: Integer active/startup counts and continuous output; fixed per-unit limits and linear demand, reserve and transition conditions.

shortest_path.rationale: Binary arcs with linear flow conservation and fixed arc costs.

small_bucket_lot_sizing.rationale: Linear inventory/backlog balances, binary production/startup decisions and fixed machine-capacity/setup-time coefficients.

max_min_dispersion.rationale: Binary pair activation admits exact AND linearization; minimum distance represented by a continuous bound and fixed-distance big-M rows.

inventory_backlogging.rationale: Linear inventory/backlog balance and fixed-demand-derived setup bound; additive order, holding and backlog costs.

shift_assignment.rationale: Binary shift assignments with fixed availability and skills, linear demand/slack equations and additive penalties.

factory_planning.rationale: Linear manufacture/store/sell balances, fixed resource coefficients and sales/storage capacities; linear profit.

nonlinear.rationale: Official question explicitly contains quadratic/conic feasibility restrictions (squared variables), not merely linear objectives.
